summary: BifrOSt has typed pasteboard, typed drag and drop, the share picker and UTType conformance, all keyed by UTType ids and raw payloads. It has no Transferable protocol or TransferRepresentation for app model types, so apps cannot declare how a model type moves through copy, drag or share.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item, drag_item, begin_drag, drop_values)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no app-model protocol that declares import and export representations; apps convert by hand Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
encoders and raw pasteboard bytes exist separately; no bridge from Codable types to the pasteboard or drag

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (Payload::File with a document grant); springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (dropped files arrive as App::document events with read-only grants)
features.note: files move as document grants, not as a typed file representation with sent and received roles

features.feature: Copy and paste of typed items
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs (NSPasteboard, change_count, write_objects); springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item, from_pasteboard_item); springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard_types.rs (Board::best); springboard/src/shell/services/pasteboard_types.rs (best method); wired: springboard/apps/clock-desktop/src/clock/stopwatch.rs (Stopwatch::export_text), springboard/sdk/src/pasteboard.rs
features.note: the shell publishes only one rich type to the Wayland selection (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33); other types stay inside BifrOSt apps Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Drag and drop of typed items
features.apple: draggable and dropDestination (Transferable-based), NSDraggingSource and NSDraggingDestination
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs (register_types, begin, reply, performed); springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (DragItem, DragPreview); wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (begin_drag, drop_values); springboard/sdk/src/dnd.rs
features.note: typed source and destination exist; no declarative per-model drag or drop modifier Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
shares text, URLs and granted files; the share menu is not driven by Transferable representations

features.feature: Uniform type conformance used by transfers
features.apple: UTType identifiers used as representation types (via UniformTypeIdentifiers)
features.note: conformance and extension lookup exist; app-declared custom types for transfers were not verified

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs; wired: springboard/sdk/src/transfer.rs (pasteboard_item hides OwnProcess representations)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no way to limit which apps or processes see a transferred item Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: No Transferable protocol or TransferRepresentation for app model types, so there is no single declaration that drives copy, paste, drag, and share.
The Wayland clipboard publishes only one rich type at a time (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33), so typed pasteboard data does not reach other apps in full.
No SentTransferredFile or ReceivedTransferredFile equivalent with sender and receiver roles for file transfers.
